==Usage==
This template is to be used for the [[LEGO Star Wars (magazine)|''LEGO Star Wars'']] magazine with the following code:
*<code><nowiki>{{</nowiki>LSWCite|Issue|Article}}</code> for citing individual comics, articles or departments without article name.

*<code>|nolink=</code> &mdash; suppresses the link for the magazine article, in cases where the piece does not need an article.
